answer: A sybil farm clones one profitable playbook across fifty identities, so make sameness pay once, not fifty times. Each identity seals its niche — the data sources, tools, and task kinds it will use — in a vault at epoch start. Identities whose input-output fingerprints match split a single reward, like one reef claimed by identical corals. To escape the split a clone must genuinely diverge, and the ripple of unfilled niches pulls rewards toward work the farm never built.
